name: Forget
description: Forget one fact in every place it was copied (notes, old versions, search indexes, summaries, chat records, backups) and hand back a receipt that names the places it cannot reach. Preview by default: it searches and changes nothing until mode is apply.

mode.description: off = load nothing; preview = the forget tool and memory.forget find every copy and report, change nothing; apply = a preview hands out a one-time confirm code, and passing it back redacts every copy it can reach.

extraRoots.description: More folders to sweep as notes (absolute or ~/...). The workspace notes, memorySearch.extraPaths, Claude Code's autoMemoryDirectory, the state dir's memory, wiki, agent transcripts and the engram stores are always swept.

backupDirs.description: Folders that hold backups (default <stateDir>/backups). Text files in them are redacted; archives and encrypted bundles are listed as out of reach.

remoteCopies.description: Copies outside this machine the owner knows of, e.g. "encrypted nightly backup on Google Drive". Each is listed on every receipt as out of reach.

claudeCode.description: Also sweep Claude Code's transcripts and prompt history (~/.claude/projects, ~/.claude/history.jsonl), where the cc-bridge chat workers keep their own copy of each chat.

gitHistory.description: Search the git history of every swept folder that is a repository, and list the commits and remotes that still hold the fact. It never rewrites history.

maxBinaryScanMB.description: Binary stores (SQLite, vector files) larger than this are listed as not searched instead of read.
